lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
educai-admin: 3,886 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 2,065 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 1,328 B, generated by typescript 249 B.
educai-personal: 3,886 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 2,065 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 1,328 B, generated by typescript 249 B.
educai-bot-picker: 315 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 290 B, generated by typescript 17 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
educai-main: 407 B beyond the first copy, generated by @vitejs/plugin-vue2 278 B, generated by vite 121 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
core-js, 10,456 B on the educai-admin page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
297,703 B in 1,563 pieces of 10 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (32 packages, 141 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
